question: Mahatma Gandhi launched the Quit India Movement for freedom from the British in the year:
solution:
__
 
• The correct answer is **1942**__.
 
• **Mahatma Gandhi **launched the **Quit India Movement** for freedom from the British in the year **1942**.
 
• **Quit India Movement** also known as** August Kranti**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• On** 8th August 1942,** Mahatma Gandhi gave a clarion call to end British rule and launched the Quit India Movement at the session of the All-India Congress Committee in Mumbai.
